pricingTransparency.headline: Why MicroPatches Pricing Is Different
pricingTransparency.intro: Traditional production can make sense for large bulk runs. MicroPatches is built to be cheaper and simpler for small custom orders, while still offering aggressive quantity pricing for larger orders.

bullets.text: May require mold or setup fees
Lower unit prices usually depend on larger quantities
Design changes may require a new mold
Final cost can depend on quantity, mold, backing, size, shipping, and production method
Flat $25 design and work up fee
Built for one offs, small batches, gifts, collectors, teams, units, and departments
Clear unit pricing plus the design fee

pricingTransparency.note: The design and work up fee is flat per custom design, not per item. Pricing tabs below show unit pricing and when the design fee may be waived.

pricing.globalNote: All pricing is estimate based and subject to final artwork review. Custom requests may vary by size, thickness, artwork detail, quantity, and production requirements. Do not submit payment information through the quote form.
pricing.designFeeNote: The $25 design and work up fee prepares custom artwork for MicroPatches production and serves as a non refundable deposit. The fee is flat per custom design, not per item. The fee may be waived for qualifying larger orders. Do not submit payment information through the quote form.

groups.name: MicroPins
groups.description: Small custom pin products for agencies, teams, units, public safety groups, supporters, and collectors.

groups.name: MicroCharms
groups.description: Compact shoe charms for Croc style clogs and similar vented footwear.

groups.name: Flexible Patch
groups.description: Custom flexible, durable, raised texture patch style products. These are not PVC patches and are not embroidered patches.

pricing.fee: Quoted by size, detail, backing, and quantity

groups.note: Small: 2 x 2 in to 3 x 2 in. Standard Uniform: 3 x 3 in to 4 x 5 in. Full Size Replica: made 1 to 1 with the original patch being modeled. Oversized Flexible Patch style products require a custom quote.

groups.name: Challenge Coins
groups.description: Custom raised texture challenge coin style products for agencies, units, teams, events, supporters, and collectors.
groups.note: Challenge Coin style products are custom raised texture products. They are not described as metal coins unless approved later.
